# Fellowship Event Hall

> Fellowship Event Hall is a modern event venue located on the property of St. Mary Romanian Orthodox Church in Dacula, GA. It is available for rent to the public for weddings, birthday parties, corporate events, and other private celebrations.

## About

- Full name: Fellowship Event Hall (also known as Saint Mary's Fellowship Hall)
- Parent organization: St. Mary Romanian Orthodox Church, serving the American-Romanian community in Gwinnett County, GA
- Location: 2875 Winder Hwy, Dacula, GA 30019
- Website: https://events.saintmaryro.org
- Phone: +1-404-518-1042
- Email: events@saintmaryro.org
- Coordinates: 33.9922° N, 83.8866° W

## Venue

- Capacity: seats up to 250 guests, accommodates up to 300 for standing receptions
- Square footage: approximately 5,000 sq ft
- Parking: large, dedicated on-site parking lot
- Features: modern design, multiple decoration options, private green space, flexible hours
- Amenities included in every package: tables, chairs, tablecloths, chair covers, basic sound system, setup and cleanup assistance, on-site coordinator, parking access

## Hours

- Every day: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST
- Tours are by appointment

## Packages & Pricing

All packages include tables, chairs, tablecloths, chair covers, sound system, setup/cleanup, and an on-site coordinator. Refundable deposits of $1,500 (damage) and $1,000 (cleaning) are required.

| Capacity   | Price  |
|------------|--------|
| 50 guests  | $2,000 |
| 100 guests | $2,500 |
| 150 guests | $3,000 |
| 200 guests | $3,500 |
| 250 guests | $4,000 |

Named tiers used in our materials:
- Intimate Gathering — 50 guests, $2,000
- Grand Celebration — 150 guests, $3,000 (most popular)
- Majestic Event — 250 guests, $4,000

Prices are subject to change. Contact us for a custom quote.

## Event Types Hosted

- Weddings and receptions
- Birthday parties and quinceañeras
- Corporate events and team gatherings
- Baptisms, christenings, and religious celebrations
- Anniversaries and family reunions
- Community and nonprofit events

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is the guest capacity of Fellowship Event Hall?**
A: Fellowship Event Hall comfortably seats up to 250 guests and can accommodate up to 300 attendees for standing receptions. The space is approximately 5,000 square feet.

**Q: Where is Fellowship Event Hall located?**
A: We are located at 2875 Winder Hwy, Dacula, GA 30019 — roughly 45 minutes northeast of downtown Atlanta, and convenient to Lawrenceville, Buford, Hoschton, Duluth, and Suwanee.

**Q: Is parking available on site?**
A: Yes. Our property includes a large on-site parking lot with ample space for your guests at no additional charge.

**Q: Can we bring in our own catering and alcohol?**
A: Yes — outside catering is welcome, and our prep kitchen is available to vendors. Alcohol is permitted under our standard rental guidelines, which we will review with you before booking.

**Q: What is included in the rental?**
A: Every rental includes tables and chairs, tablecloths and chair covers, a basic sound system, on-site parking, an on-site coordinator, and setup and cleanup assistance. Higher-tier packages add premium linens, a bridal suite, enhanced sound and lighting, and dedicated coordination.

**Q: How do we book a tour or check availability?**
A: Private venue tours are available by appointment. Use the contact form or send a WhatsApp message and we will follow up promptly with open dates.

**Q: How much does it cost to rent Fellowship Event Hall?**
A: Packages start at $2,000 for 50 guests and scale up to $4,000 for 250 guests. Refundable deposits of $1,500 (damage) and $1,000 (cleaning) are required with each rental.
